# Docs Boilerplate

> Agent-first Docs-as-Code repository template and CLI. Markdown content and composable standards are the source of truth; the browser viewer is secondary.

Read `AGENTS.md` before changing content. The historical `business/`, `technical/` and `milestones/` trees are migration inputs, not reusable generated project documentation.
